name: @splicewire/beam-ux-prototype
description: The repo-agnostic runtime for the rushing-prototype UX-prototyping system (Beam free-tier arm; ADR-0116 rehome-ui). Ships the glob→route mount utility (createPrototypeRoutes), the generic prototyping chrome (Gallery, VariantBar, SettingsFrame, and a brand-parameterized PrototypeDesk), and the production-boundary verifier CLI, so any React+Vite host prototypes UX the way splicewire does — real @/ components rendered read-only over colocated fixtures, auto-mounted at /_prototype/<slug>, fenced from production. The load-bearing seam stays at the host: import.meta.glob is a Vite compile-time macro the host writes and passes in; everything around it is packaged. Generic UI comes from the @schemastud/ui foundation (peer); react/react-router/lucide-react are host-provided peers.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint:imports && npm run build
